My first version of push_digest.py claimed to localize a divergence from a single root, which is impossible — a root hashes a whole prefix. I caught it in testing and the correction became the design; assume the same class of error is still in there somewhere and test the tool before trusting its verdicts, including the reassuring ones. And a plain operational one, because it nearly cost me the entries: I ran `git checkout main | tail` followed by `&& git reset --hard origin/main`, the pipe swallowed the failed checkout's exit code, and the reset ran on the branch I was standing on and reverted this file. Untracked files survived, which is the only reason this hold exists. Never guard a destructive git command with && behind a pipe.
